items.excluded_from_P_arms: items whose true country has no correct main-panel item (the Pool refuses the class mean): 0.6B 6, 1.7B 5, 4B 5; scored n (readable / right-operand): 0.6B 23/9, 1.7B 17/10, 4B 11/8 (= hopmath). Arm B runs on every wrong item; its amplitude probes exist only for non-excluded items

objects.pools: mdb Pools at cache.L<x>.v[kv<kv_c>,row=@carrier] over correct main-panel items, x in the band [L_c-3, L_c+1], label country (= country_token); and over the wrong items at L_c. Collected natively (bf16, mdb prefill path), sealed, saved, reloaded in every phase.
objects.code: per item and layer: m_all = pool.mean_for(item) (leave-one-out over correct items), m_c = pool.class_mean_for(item, by=country) (leave-one-out, same true country); d = (m_c - m_all)/|m_c - m_all|; amplitude a(v) = (v - m_all).d / |m_c - m_all| in class-code units (1.0 = the mean code of the correct same-country items). The wrong item is never in any mean (it is not in the correct pool).
objects.P_true: rank-1 projector onto d (SubspaceBinding, authority fitted, PER-ITEM TEST-INFORMED: it uses the item's true country)
objects.P_span_k: SubspaceBinding class_mean_subspace: top-k PCA of the centred class means of all countries in the correct pool, k in {1, 4, 16} (fitted; test-informed at the CLASS level: the wrong item's own country is one of the classes, the item itself is not)
objects.dose: v(alpha) = v + (alpha - 1) P (v - m_all), i.e. the component of (v - m_all) in P scaled by alpha, everything else unchanged; alpha in {0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8}
objects.consumer: Margin(last row, truth, b) with b = the top non-truth token of the native run (the model's wrong answer on wrong items); flip/repair = full-vocabulary argmax == truth
objects.floor: Branches' shared floor: 2 bf16 spacings at the larger |logit| of the base margin (+ 2x the measured batched-vs-stepped null delta on batched arms); stability band: |dM| >= 4 floors stable, else kernel-sensitive (treated as unresolved, not as an effect)

arms.A: native bf16 (Beast GPU), answer-row footing: run with prefill = last row, the carrier cell cache.L_c.v[kv_c,row=carrier] replaced by v(alpha). All P_true and P_span arms batched (sweep.cell_sweep), P_true arms re-measured on the mdb stepped path (the authority for P1). Nulls (stepped): matched-norm random like T3 and T8, self-patch like T2. alpha* = smallest alpha whose stepped argmax is the truth.
arms.E1: exploratory, sealed: correct items, P_true dose-down alpha in {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75} (batched)
arms.B: native bf16, true back-patch at the carrier row: run with prefill = carrier row (rows before it are unaffected by an edit at the carrier row, so this equals a rerun from the span's first row by causality), Branches at t<row>.L<L_c-8>.h; arm B<s>_<t> writes the base run's own h at t<row>.L<s>.h into t<row>.L<t>.h, s in {L_c+2, L_c+4, L_c+6, L-1}, t in {L_c-8, L_c-6, L_c-4, L_c-2} (16 pairs), continued to the answer row's logits. Nulls: a matched-norm random add like every pair (16), self-patch like B<L_c+4>_<L_c-4>. Probes (Branches.probes, read before restore): the carrier amplitude a_x at cache.L<x>.v[kv_c,row=carrier] for x in the band [L_c-3, L_c+1] (each with its own layer's Pool directions) and |v| at L_c.
arms.C: fp32 replica from mdb core files (bf16 prefix cache dumped by the native run at row=last, answer row recomputed in fp32; Run.core_check null check recorded): the P_true dose ladder again (alpha*_fp32), then at alpha*_fp32 symbols.hop_edge (cell_layer L_c, top 256 neurons per layer by |effect|) on the base and edited replica runs. Switch set: neurons in L_c+1..L_c+4 (L21-L24 on 1.7B) whose gate pre-activation g changes sign between the base and edited runs, among the listed top-256, ranked by |effect|; S_N = the top N with N = the item's country's exp5 composer count in the same layers (1.7B only; 32 per country). Jaccard(S_N, composers) against 200 random same-size sets from the same layers.
arms.F_2.3: fp32 replica, correct base items: donor swap v -> v + alpha (m_donor_country - v) with m_donor_country = the pool's class mean of the donor's country (all its correct items), consumer M = logit(answer) - logit(donor answer), alpha in {0.25, 0.5, 1, 2}; hop_edge per dose (per-layer exact MLP and re-read terms); symbols.gate_switch_forecast at alpha=1: F1 = direct + linear MLP (one-layer Jacobian on the actual input change, the hop-math first-order total), F2[k] = F1 with the k largest-|Jacobian Delta g| gates per layer replaced by the exact finite SwiGLU of their Jacobian-predicted (Delta g, Delta u), k in {8, 32, 128}, F3[k] = the chained passive version (residual change starts as the cell layer's direct write, each layer's F2-style MLP change fed forward, later re-reads not forecast). Flip: M0 + delta < 0. Log-slope per layer = log2(term(2 alpha)/term(alpha)) for the exact MLP term, median over items and over the two steps 0.5->1, 1->2 (items with |term| > 0.05 at both doses).

changes_from_memo: P for arm A: the memo's rank-k class-mean projector (k in {1,4}) is replaced by the item's own TRUE-country direction (rank 1, per-item test-informed) as the primary arm, with the class-mean span k in {1,4,16} as a second, labelled arm. Reason: das 11b measured the country code as high-rank and per-country; a shared rank-1/4 span is known to move little (0/64 at k<=8 in interchange).

dose grid extended from {0.5..3} to {0.5..8}: a rank-1 handle on a high-rank code may need more gain than the memo assumed; without the extension a 'no flip by 3' would be ambiguous between 'no threshold' and 'threshold above 3'.
P1 alpha* band widened from [1.2, 2.0] to [1.25, 4.0] for the same reason; the memo's band is reported beside it.

P3 'every repairing pair raises |Pv| by >= 1.3x' becomes >= 0.8 of repairing arms (bf16 kernel noise on a rank-1 projection; 'every' would be decided by one arm); a raise is defined in class-code units (a_after - a_native >= 0.3, or a_after/a_native >= 1.3 when a_native > 0.1), because readable items can have a_native <= 0 where a ratio is meaningless.

P4 Jaccard bar lowered from 0.3 to 0.15: the exp5 composer sets were nominated for CAPITAL answers on Run 1 prompts, while every wrong item here has a LANGUAGE answer (d3/d4/d5); hop-math measured that language rides the same L21-L24 band at about 0.7x the capital's MLP share, so partial overlap is the expectation. The memo's 0.3 is reported beside it.
P4 is tested on Qwen3-1.7B only (the only model with an exp5 composer set); 0.6B and 4B report switch counts only.

predictions.P1: On right-operand wrong items (P_true, stepped): (a) M(alpha) is non-decreasing over the dose grid on >= 0.8 of items, a step counting as a violation only when M drops by more than 1 floor; (b) the argmax flips to the truth at some alpha <= 8 on >= 0.5 of items and the median alpha* over flipped items lies in [1.25, 4.0] (memo band [1.2, 2.0] reported); (c) threshold: the critical amplitude a_native * alpha* over flipped items has q75/q25 <= 2.5 and median in [0.5, 2.0] class-code units. On readable wrong items P_true flips <= 0.3 of items by alpha = 8.
predictions.P2: The native amplitude a (P_true, L_c) of correct items exceeds that of right-operand wrong items with AUC >= 0.75 (pooled Mann-Whitney per model; correct items restricted to the countries of the right-operand items); readable wrong items have median a <= 0.3 and below the right-operand median.
predictions.P3: Arm B (stepped): (a) the exists-any repair rate (any of the 16 pairs, argmax == truth) in the right-operand stratum is >= 2x that of the readable stratum, judged per model when the model has >= 4 repairing items, else pooled over models; (b) >= 0.8 of repairing (item, pair) arms raise the carrier amplitude at L_c (raise defined above); (c) arms that do not raise it repair on <= 0.1 of (item, pair) arms and at <= 1/3 the rate of raising arms; (d) matched-norm random arms repair at <= 1/3 the rate of true back-patch arms.
predictions.P4: Qwen3-1.7B, fp32 replica at alpha*_fp32: median Jaccard(S_N, exp5 composers of the true country, L21-L24) >= 0.15 against a random same-size median <= 0.01 (memo bar 0.3 reported).
predictions.S_span: Exploratory, sealed: P_span16 flips at least as many right-operand items as P_true by alpha = 8; P_span1 and P_span4 flip fewer than P_true.
predictions.E1: Exploratory, sealed: on correct items, removing the true-country component (alpha = 0) loses the argmax on <= 0.2 of items (a rank-1 removal of a high-rank code), with median M(0)/M(1) in [0.4, 0.9].
predictions.F_2.3: (memo §2.3, kept) F2[32] median ratio to native >= 0.85 and flip-set mismatch <= 0.125 of items; F3[32] mismatch <= 0.0625 of items; on 1.7B the median MLP log-slope is 1.3-1.6 at L21-L24 and 0.9-1.1 at L25-L27; on 4B the re-read term's log-slope exceeds 1.5. Replication check: F1 median ratio in [0.45, 0.75] (memo measured 0.59).

falsifiers.amplitude: P2 AUC < 0.6: the code's strength along the true direction is not what fails.
falsifiers.threshold: P1: alpha* scattered over the whole grid with non-monotone M(alpha) on > 0.3 of right-operand items: no threshold.
falsifiers.timing_vs_amplification: P3: arm-B repairs equal across strata (ratio < 1.25), or >= 0.5 of repairing arms with no amplitude rise (a_after - a_native < 0.1): back-patching is not amplification and the timing account stands.
falsifiers.gate_switch: §2.3: F2[128] median ratio < 0.75 (the gap is dense, not a few switched gates), or the MLP log-slope is flat across layers (|L21-24 slope - L25-27 slope| < 0.1).
